scenarios.title: Happy Path - Document Upload
scenarios.description: Upload a document via the /api/documents POST endpoint
steps: Send a POST request to /api/documents with a valid document attached as multipart/form-data
Verify the request returns a 201 Created status code
scenarios.expected_result: The document is uploaded and a Document record is persisted in the database with the correct filename

scenarios.title: Alternate Flow - Document Upload with Different File Types
scenarios.description: Upload different types of documents via the /api/documents POST endpoint
steps: Send a POST request to /api/documents with different types of documents (e.g., PDF, DOCX, JPEG) attached as multipart/form-data
Verify the request returns a 201 Created status code for each file type
scenarios.expected_result: Each document is uploaded and a Document record is persisted in the database with the correct filename

scenarios.title: Role Based - Document Upload by Different User Roles
scenarios.description: Upload a document via the /api/documents POST endpoint with different user roles
pre_conditions: User is authenticated with different roles
steps: Send a POST request to /api/documents with a valid document attached as multipart/form-data for each user role
Verify the request returns a 201 Created status code for each user role
scenarios.expected_result: The document is uploaded and a Document record is persisted in the database with the correct filename for each user role
